_note: Arrow wounds on atronachs, gargoyles and ash guardians: arrows burn up in fire, shatter ice, crack stone. Overrides the arrow source over common.json. Schema: ../guide.md (Groups). No numbers in narration.

levels: , the arrow striking with a flare of light; pieces chip away around the point. {name} flickers and presses on.
, the arrowhead driving in where the body is already cracked. The crack splits wider and force spills out around the shaft, hissing; {name} lets out a grinding roar.
, and the arrow breaks deep into the wound. The inner force bursts out in a violent flare and {name} staggers, shape buckling.
, and it is too much. {name} sags, the glow guttering, pieces crumbling away around the arrows.
